items.name: Pool
items.summary: A thread safe pool that works in an `alloc`-only context.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Get a value from the pool. The caller is guaranteed to have exclusive access to the given value. Namely, it is guaranteed that this will never return a value that was returned by another call to `get` but was not put back into the pool.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new pool. The given closure is used to create values in the pool when necessary.

items.name: PoolGuard
items.signature: struct PoolGuard<'a, T: Send, F: Fn() -> T>
items.summary: A guard that is returned when a caller requests a value from the pool.

methods.name: put
methods.summary: Consumes this guard and puts it back into the pool.
